svg.title: A storyboard shows every picture as large as it can: A whole GitLab page gets a row of its own in a storyboard, at its real size
svg.text: A storyboard shows every picture as large as it can
Scenario: A whole GitLab page gets a row of its own in a storyboard, at its real size

g.text: Then a storyboard gives a whole GitLab page a full row at its real size
and keeps shorter captures two per row
A storyboard drawn by the real engine from five pictures: a short terminal capture, a whole
GitLab page 1440 pixels wide, a long output strip 960 pixels wide, a second terminal capture
The 1440 pixel page takes the full width of the board and keeps its real size, so its small
text stays readable. Its long note wraps at a comfortable width instead of running across the
The other pictures share rows two by two. The 960 pixel strip is shrunk into its half of the
row. The tall page has to be shrunk to fit the height limit anyway, so it keeps a half row. A
picture alone on its row sits in the middle of it.

svg.text: Storyboard e2e · 1 steps · 1 frames · every frame is its own pixel baseline (tolerance: 0)
